items.title: Collect a Nuka-Cola Dark
items.detail: Check Eta Psi house basement or buy from Bubbles at Whitespring Resort

items.title: Collect Pre-war Food
items.detail: Use C.A.M.P. food generator or loot Sunday Brothers' Cabin basement

items.title: Collect a Microscope or Biometric Scanner
items.detail: West Tek Research Center has multiple Microscopes in various rooms

items.title: Complete the Event: "Mischief Night"
items.detail: Join at Rapidan Camp on the hour, light the pyre and follow the Eyebot

items.title: Kill a Lost during the "Mischief Night" Event
items.detail: Kill Lost Dwellers during the Mischief Night event; need 6 kills

items.title: Kill an Enemy with a Shovel during the "Disturbed Grave" Quest
items.detail: Equip shovel after starting quest; kills anywhere count, not just at grave

items.title: Visit your Shelter
items.detail: Fast travel to your C.A.M.P. and enter your Shelter

items.title: Drink Tea
items.detail: Use C.A.M.P. Company Tea generator or find tea at locations

items.title: Kill a Mole Miner
items.detail: Fast travel to Blackwater Mine for reliable spawn; aim for head with V.A.T.S.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during a Daily Operation while on a Team!
items.detail: Join any team, enter Daily Ops; Phantoms are the masked cultists; no need to finish the op

items.title: Kill a Rusted Deathclaw
items.detail: Fast travel to Dino Peaks Mini Golf for 3 spawns; aim for belly with V.A.T.S.

items.title: Kill an Uninvited Pint-Sized Phantom
items.detail: Complete Mischief Night event and stay near Vertibot to find party crasher spawn

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Aluminum
items.detail: Craft Bulk Aluminum at Tinker's Workbench then scrap it

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Antiseptic
items.detail: Scrap Abraxo cleaner or other Antiseptic items; farm Ticks at Big B's Rest Stop

items.title: Sell Mirelurk Queen Steak to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Kill Mirelurk Queen at Mac's Farm or Spruce Knob Lake; sell to any vendor

items.title: Travel on foot (KM)
items.detail: Sprint without fast traveling; aim for 50 km; keep weapon holstered for speed

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Complete all six daily challenges on three separate days this week

events.name: Slasher C.A.M.P. Contest
events.description: Build a slasher-themed C.A.M.P. or Shelter and submit for a chance to win Atoms and exclusive titles.

events.name: Mischief Night
events.description: Seasonal public event at Rapidan Camp featuring Pint-Sized Phantoms and mayhem activities with themed rewards.

events.name: Double Mutations
events.description: Increased mutation acquisition rate during Daily Operations with seasonal rewards.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Spooky-themed Scorched enemies appear with special seasonal rewards and challenges.

events.name: Double XP Weekend
events.description: Experience gains are doubled, perfect for leveling up and Scoreboard progression.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Increased chance to catch seasonal fish during this limited-time fishing event.
